name: newsroom-pets
description: CLAUDE_NEWS newsroom pets: colored pixel characters in the band above the prompt act out each wiki operation (writing, reading, searching, the log, the index shelf, the radar, printing, phoning, dispatching, gates turning red or green, commit stamps, push paper planes) for the editor (main session) and each reporter subagent; the editor naps in two rows otherwise. Observes only. Inert outside the CLAUDE_NEWS tree.
